answer: Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it. The sable detector writes each match to the forge queue, and the marble checkpoint records the escalation and the frozen amount. A submitter whose answers share 10 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 36% of its pending payouts meanwhile. That is 31 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
